name: pi-goal-x
notes:
v0.31.6 sync: adopted upstream's prompt-cache fix (#67/#68): context hook appends live goal state at the request tail (pi-goal-live-context) instead of prepending, compactGoalCheckpointContext rewrites every checkpoint marker in place (no mid-history deletion that shifted the cache prefix), before_agent_start no longer injects changing state into the system prompt, and cacheGoalHistory moves existing Anthropic/Bedrock cache breakpoints before the transient tail. Fork additions preserved: persisted pi-goal-context-event channel (re-sent on session_compact), pi-goal-state-event snapshots, ui_prompt_start/end Escape-to-dialog depth (reset on session_start), change-manifest baseline capture, constant tool-surface install (installGoalTools); goal-context-filter.test.ts rewritten for compactGoalCheckpointContext semantics. Missing upstream APIs re-added: shouldInjectPostCompactReminder, buildPostCompactionGoalDelta, armPostCompactReminder/isPostCompactReminderPending/clearPostCompactReminder/consumePostCompactReminder were absent in the fork's v0.31.5 sync and are now restored. Known pre-existing debt (not from this sync): tests/goal-auditor-package.test.ts D-04/D-05 fail because pi-subagents 0.15.0 injects contact_supervisor into the goal-auditor declaredBuiltin list. Known new debt (upstream-original, left unchanged per debt policy): pi-lens findings on run-gate.mjs (JSON.parse without try/catch), goal-prompt-cache.ts (no-unknown-returns), goal-prompt-cache-sdk.test.ts, and goal-prompt-cache.test.ts. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: package-lock.json restored to upstream bytes (pnpm monorepo never reads it; restore again after each pull); catch-comment/indentation noise reverted (goal-prompts.ts keeps upstream space-indent inside cachedPrompt/retainedTaskChars; goal-policy.ts byte-identical); the post-compact reminder tests removed during the v0.31.5 gap were restored (goal-policy.test.ts, goal-accounting-runtime.test.ts). tsconfig target stays ES2023 deliberately — reverting to ES2022 breaks typecheck. Fork settings cases moved from tests/goal-layered-settings.test.ts (byte-identical to upstream again) to fork-only tests/goal-fork-settings.test.ts (registered in .test-manifest.json). Copy note: pausedGateBlock/budgetReachedReminderNote/auditorRejectionNote wording is duplicated inline in goal-events.ts currentGoalContext — three same-source copies; if upstream rewords the policy text, sync the snapshot side. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: the pi-subagents delegation executor (runGoalCompletionAuditor, structured-result parsing, usage/progress handling) moved from extensions/goal-auditor.ts to fork-only extensions/goal-auditor-delegation.ts; goal-auditor.ts keeps prompt building, AuditorProgress types and re-exports so goal-completion.ts/goal-oracle.ts and most tests need no import changes (tests/goal-auditor.test.ts imports shifted). 2026-09-19 audit-customization pass (fork 0.8.0): the default goal-auditor is no longer a package agent markdown — agents/goal-auditor.md was deleted and the canonical definition (verbatim system prompt + frontmatter fields) moved into fork-only extensions/goal-auditor-registration.ts, which registers it at session_start through pi-subagents' runtime-agent-register:v1 event (registerAgentViaEvents from @xzzpig/pi-subagents/agents) and skips registration when a configured goal-auditor exists (old ejected md files keep working). Registration never shadows: any non-missing_agent preflight outcome skips, because runtime/configured name collisions throw at discovery. package.json dropped pi.subagents.agents and the files entry, so a future sync that re-adds agents/goal-auditor.md upstream will need this deletion re-applied (and the temp-dir PI_SUBAGENT_EXTRA_AGENT_DIRS materialization in goal-auditor-delegation.ts must NOT be restored — runtime registration covers bare pi -e). /goal-subagent-eject was removed (pi-subagents ejectAgentDefinition cannot eject runtime agents). Settings gained the nested auditor group (parse-time legacy aliases: disabled/auditorAgent/provider/model/thinkingLevel/auditorTimeoutMs/changeManifest/changeManifestDepth fold into auditor.* leaves, nested wins per file, no deprecated_key diagnostics because diagnostics flip layer status to invalid and block mutations); resolved shape drops those flat fields — future upstream syncs adding flat auditor settings must map through the nested group. Prompt injections live in buildGoalAuditorPrompt (goal-auditor.ts): checklist/checklistExtra/evidenceRequests/strictness/instructions/reportFormat render after the checklist in fixed order, escapePromptPayload-escaped, protocol tail always preserved, byte-identical when unset; feedbackNotes appends to rejectionText in goal-completion.ts. tests/goal-command-palette.test.ts is no longer byte-identical to upstream (eject tests removed, REMOVED_COMMANDS gained goal-subagent-eject).
2026-09-21 conflict-surface pass (pre-commit): tests/integration/extension.test.ts restored to upstream bytes (empty catch{} left as upstream debt; the earlier 'best-effort temp-dir cleanup' comment on upstream-original lines was removed per the never-annotate rule, and the } finally { indentation noise reverted) — the only remaining diff vs HEAD is the intentional continue_working→continue_audit assertion rename. appendAuditUsageEntry moved out of upstream goal-completion.ts into fork-only extensions/goal-auditor-delegation.ts (exported; re-exported through goal-auditor.ts's fork re-export block); goal-completion.ts keeps only the call seams. STRUCTURAL RISK (documented for future syncs): CHANGELOG.md and README.md are UPSTREAM files that the fork has long diverged (fork version line 0.8.x coexists with upstream 0.31.x history; CHANGELOG keeps upstream entries plus fork entries at the top, README is fork-rewritten) — every upstream sync will conflict on both files; keep the fork section on top of the upstream history and re-apply the fork wording. goal-completion.ts raw-vs-w numstat still differs by 8/8 lines but ONLY as code-move noise (appendAuditUsageEntry extraction + interrupted branch restructure), prettier-clean; no formatting drift.
